name: Ghostbuster Detection
description: Applies Ghostbuster method combining multiple weak signals — structured search over feature combinations (Verma et al., 2023).
mechanism:
The Ghostbuster Detection method implements the technique from Verma et al. (2023) for detecting AI-generated text using structured search over weaker language models:

1. **Feature向量Construction**: The input text is processed through a series of weaker, unstructured language models (e.g., unigram, bigram, trigram models and a small GPT-like model). For each token, the probability assigned by each model is computed, yielding per-token probability vectors from multiple model perspectives.

2. **Document-LevelFeatureAggregation**: Token-level probabilities are aggregated into document-level features using selected functions: mean, variance, and quantile statistics of log-probabilities from each model. This creates a compact feature vector capturing the distributional characteristics of the text through multiple linguistic lenses.

3. **StructuredSearchoverFeatureCombinations**: A structured search selects the most discriminative combination of features and models. Rather than relying on a single powerful model, Ghostbuster combines signals from multiple weaker models — exploiting the observation that AI-generated text exhibits characteristic probability patterns across different model architectures.

4. **Linear分类**: The selected feature vector is fed into a trained logistic regression classifier. The linear model ensures interpretability and robustness — avoiding overfitting to specific generator architectures. The decision boundary separates human-written text (which shows variable probability across models) from AI-generated text (which tends to be uniformly probable across models).

5. **Confidence评分**: The classifier output probability provides a confidence score. Texts near the decision boundary are flagged as uncertain, while those with strong signals from multiple feature dimensions receive high-confidence predictions. The method generalizes across different AI generators without requiring per-model training.

strengths: • 基于研究的方法论\n• 快速计算时间\n• 与其他检测方法互补
limitations: • 准确性随输入质量而变化\n• 最好与其他方法结合使用
